paper.title_en: Teichmüller spaces with conical singularities and Virasoro coadjoint orbits
paper.abstract_en: We study Teichmüller spaces of hyperbolic \(0\)-metrics on a disk with ideal boundary and a marked point carrying a conical singularity with angle $θ= 2πβ$. For all $β>0$, we show that $\rm{Teich}^β(\overline{\mathbb D})\cong S^1\backslash \rm{Diff}(S^1)$, and we construct natural closed 2-forms $ω_β$ induced by the Atiyah-Bott construction. For non-integer $β$, the form $ω_β$ is symplectic, and one can identify $\rm{Teich}^β(\overline{\mathbb D})$ with the corresponding elliptic Virasoro coadjoint orbit. For positive integers $β=n$, $ω_β$ is presymplectic, and it descends to the Kirillov-Kostant-Souriau symplectic form on the exceptional Virasoro orbit $\mathrm{PSU}^{(n)}(1,1)\backslash\rm{Diff}(S^1)$. Infinitesimal isometries of a hyperbolic \(0\)-metric on a disk with a conical singularity with angle $θ=2πn$ are given by the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb R)$ which integrates to the group $\mathrm{PSU}^{(n)}(1,1)$ on the boundary of the disk but not in the interior for $n>1$. It is remarkable that the presymplectic structure of the corresponding Teichmüller spaces recovers this group and descends to the corresponding Virasoro coadjoint orbit.
